clips.title: The story
paras: At Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale, night elves gather luminous, magically charged Fallen Moonstones from its tranquil waters. Sacred lunar energy gives the stones restorative power that can renew vitality and cure severe frailty.

Southeast of Astranaar, Fallen Sky Lake once yielded many stones along its shores and shallows. Night elves prized their restorative magic and lunar blessing when ordinary remedies failed. Gathering them grew dangerous after corrupt Shadethicket bog beasts overran the lake. Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, hoarded every stone it found on a small island at the lake’s center, cutting the local Kaldorei off from a vital source of healing.
